This is a digital portfolio and resume site created by me, Genevieve Heydt.

I currently work as a Project Lead for a Data Engineering team at Auto-Owners Insurance in Michigan.

title: Projects
text:
This project involves analyzing the job market for insurance data engineers, focusing on trends, demand, and required skills. The analysis includes data collection from job postings, statistical analysis, and visualization to provide insights into the current state of the job market for professionals in this field. This project was done through a Big Data and Cloud Analytics course through Boston University, and was a group project.

title: About Me: Genevieve Heydt
text:
I am currently working on my Master’s through Boston University, my interests are in software development and analytics. My experience has specifically been in data management and actuarial mathematics, but I love to learn new things!
My professional career has kept me on my toes with shifts in technology and the need to constantly develop new skills, and I am always focused on what comes next.
My current position is in on the Data Engineering team, specializing in insurance claims data.
